steps.action:
# Three Strategies for Reducing Carbon Emissions in Cities

## 1. 🚌 Transform Transportation
- Expand public transit (buses, trains, metro systems)
- Build protected cycling infrastructure
- Transition city fleets to electric vehicles
- Implement congestion pricing to reduce car use

## 2. 🏢 Improve Building Efficiency
- Retrofit existing buildings with better insulation
- Mandate energy-efficient standards for new construction
- Switch heating systems from fossil fuels to electric heat pumps
- Install solar panels on rooftops

## 3. 🌳 Shift Energy & Land Use
- Power the city grid with renewable energy sources
- Expand green spaces to absorb CO₂
- Reduce waste sent to landfills (which produce methane)
- Support local food systems to cut supply chain emissions

---

**Key principle:** The most effective approach combines **policy** (regulations), **infrastructure** (physical changes), and **incentives** (making low-carbon choices easier and cheaper for residents).

You had plenty of time to spare! Want me to go deeper on any of these?
